short_bio: American tennis player with 23 Grand Slam singles titles, the most in the Open era.
biography:
Serena Williams was born in Saginaw, Michigan, and grew up in Compton, California, coached by her father Richard Williams. She won her first Grand Slam singles title at the 1999 US Open.

She finished with 23 Grand Slam singles titles, the most by any player in the Open era, the last at the 2017 Australian Open. She also won Olympic gold in singles at London in 2012 and in doubles with her sister Venus in 2000, 2008 and 2012.

She retired after the 2022 US Open. She founded the venture firm Serena Ventures in 2014.
